name: RetroLove
author: Jon Thysell
description: Three arcade classics in one: Pong, Breakout and Asteroids, vector style, with touch controls and keyboard. A LÖVE game running unchanged on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: Three arcade classics in one: Pong, Breakout and Asteroids, vector style, with touch controls and keyboard. A LÖVE game running unchanged on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Tre classici arcade in uno: Pong, Breakout e Asteroids in stile vettoriale, con comandi touch e tastiera. Un gioco LÖVE che gira senza modifiche sul motore Lua App.
